A 6-year-old boy is brought to the emergency department by his father for elbow pain.
He was riding his bicycle when he fell onto his outstretched right hand.
His temperature is 98.4°F (36.9°C), blood pressure is 108/64 mmHg, pulse is 100/min, and respirations are 20/min.
